messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a sharp drop in GPU reserved capacity usage for eu-west-1 last week, looks like ~38% of our A100 reserved hours went idle. billing dashboard: https://console.cloud/billing/our-account/usage :eyes:
jen: wait what — any clue why? did infra shift workloads to another region?
kai: devx moved a couple of heavy training jobs to eu-central for data locality last Tuesday, cc @maria. That would explain some delta but not all.
maria: I cross-checked allocation tags. There are 2 orphaned pools flagged `research-temp` that still have reservations attached but zero actual instances running. snippet from cost report:
```
ResourceGroup: research-temp
ReservedHours: 168
RunningHours: 0
Utilization: 0%
```
jen: ouch. Did someone forget to release them after the experiment? @samir do you know?
samir: yep that was my team's ephemeral cluster — we shut down nodes manually but forgot to update the reservation mapping. Sorry, on me. I can either move workloads back or trigger exchanges.
alex: Just to add, there's also a persistent shift: prod inference traffic that used to hit eu-west has been routed to us-east for a week due to a regional networking flap. So even if research reclaims some, we won't recover full utilization.
maria: Options: 1) exchange some reserved capacity to us-east (if possible via provider exchange), 2) convert to Savings Plan (if it covers instance family and region-flex), 3) cancel/let expire and use on-demand for the short term. Need cost delta numbers.
jen: quick back-of-envelope: at current rates, 50% idle on A100 reserved costs us ~+$12k/month in wasted spend. We can either exchange to us-east at ~10% fee or move workloads back.
kai: Is exchange automated for our vendor? I thought cross-region exchanges were limited.
maria: Provider support said exchanges allowed within same org but region change triggers an amendment fee and may require country-level approval. I filed a ticket earlier (support#4729). deploy-bot: Support ticket 4729 created and assigned to vendor-ops.
alex: Practically, research can spin up in eu-west for the next 2 weeks to soak some capacity while we decide. Samir, how fast can you redeploy?
samir: I can re-run the pipeline in eu-west tonight, but it will add some latency for that team. I'd prefer exchanging at least a subset rather than a full move.
maria: Proposal: exchange 40% of the affected reservations to us-east (covers prod backlog), keep 60% in eu-west, and put a tag policy to auto-release orphaned mapping when cluster shutdown occurs. Also enable weekly utilization alerts (threshold 75%).
jen: +1 to alerts and policy. Can someone run a 30-day forecast for the exchange fee vs. on-demand delta? I can take that.
kai: I'll add an infra automation job to enforce reservation-tag reconciliation on cluster teardown. PR incoming: `infra/reservation-cleaner`
maria: Great. Action items: samir redeploy short soak in eu-west (today), jen produce cost comparative (48h), kai PR for automation (EOW), alex keep vendor ticket hot. I'll schedule a quick sync tomorrow 10am CET. :calendar:
